description: BIM4EEB publishes building-information geometry for its demonstration buildings in a project developing a BIM toolkit for efficient building renovation. The source states that the models include external perimeter walls, structural geometry and common public spaces. Internal apartment layouts are withheld for privacy. Zenodo lists three IFC files with ITA, FIN and POL identifiers, and the metadata identifies version 1 published on 22 June 2022. The resource supplies physical building geometry for BIM-based representation and links to the project’s separately catalogued sensor measurements. It is recorded as geometry data; the source does not establish a ready-to-run energy simulation or complete thermal properties. Caveats: file contents, coordinate systems, element attributes, geometry validity and the extent of each building have not been inspected. No IFC file was downloaded. Access: free public access through Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. Related resources include the project community and the linked catalogue entries.
